text: {"lessons":["Selling winners in small amounts can lock in gains, but I should avoid treating each stock as a separate account and judge trades in the context of my whole portfolio.","My satisfaction from realizing gains can lead me to sell too early; I should weigh a stock’s prospects, valuation, and risk rather than rely on my average cost or the urge to secure a profit.","After buying Stock B back at a higher price, I should make future decisions based on its current outlook and portfolio risk—not on the earlier sale price or a desire to justify the round trip."]}
